visual_review: Before: a hook shape and a single tree; it did not read as a fire in a forest. Now: a tall licking flame at the lower left in front of two pine trees (a tall front tree and a shorter back tree sharing one outline, with two trunks).
omissions: Smoke wisps and the stepped pine tiers (the tier notches cannot keep 8 at this size).
